description: Version-scoped allowlist for OpenClaw-managed bundled extensions. Every upstream extension must be declared in keep or remove; unknown extensions fail pruning for review. JustDo-owned custom extensions are protected separately.

remove.reason: Upstream OpenAI and CLI speech directories are replaced completely by version-locked application sources. Local extension protection retains each replacement with its native plugin ID.
The desktop application uses Gateway WebSocket RPC and does not integrate the optional HTTP administration endpoint.
Public vendor APIs are unavailable in the intranet deployment. Keep OpenAI only as the protocol adapter for configured intranet model, speech and media endpoints.
External messaging, device, node and remote-control integrations are not part of the JustDo desktop runtime. Local desktop control is retained separately through cua-computer.
One-time third-party import helpers are not required for normal JustDo startup or the native session SQLite migration.
Speech, media, image and video providers are not enabled in the default desktop runtime.
Model providers not kept in the default slim runtime. Move an extension to keep only when the app owns its configuration path.
Cloudflare R2 storage locations are not integrated in the desktop application. Do not ship an unused public storage provider or introduce cloud credentials and defaults.
